summary: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing it entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Equity Residential in an all-stock merger-of-equals. The combined company will operate under a new name. Terms include an all-stock consideration; no per-share price, premium, or value stated. The filing updates the executive leadership team for the combined entity. Board recommendation and advisors not mentioned in this filing. Mechanics involve a merger-of-equals structure with no cash; regulatory approvals likely needed. Watch for shareholder votes, regulatory clearance, and post-merger integration risk.
